name: Guard Rowan
text: Ahh… my body burns and my strength is fading fast.

name: Guard Rowan
text: The healer once cured me with a mix of bright yellow berries, a hearty carrot, and a shard of crystal.

name: Guard Rowan
text: That potion glowed red — strong and fiery.

name: Guard Rowan
text: If you could make that again, I might stand tall once more.
